title: ICJ interim assessment that famine was setting in
summary: The Court assessed the deterioration in living conditions before modifying provisional measures.
claim: At the provisional-measures stage, the Court observed that Palestinians in Gaza were no longer facing only a risk of famine, but that famine was setting in.
legal_characterization: Interim factual assessment supporting modified provisional measures; not a final merits finding.
source_title: Order of 28 March 2024, Application of the Genocide Convention in the Gaza Strip (South Africa v. Israel)
verification_notes: Verified against the cited ICJ order, including its operative clause. This is a binding provisional measure at an interim stage; it is not a final merits finding that genocide occurred. Classification judgment: the statement is an interim assessment rather than an operative legal determination; manual review is requested.
